# CAD fixtures

`cube.step` / `cube.igs`: 10×10×10 mm CAD cube from https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/main/test/testfiles/cube-10x10mm ; retrieved 2026-10-19 via GitHub API without altering format.

These verify OpenCascade STEP and IGES conversion against known physical dimensions. Upstream source and licensing: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js .
